name: Early Ford CAN with KWP2000 modules (about 2003-2010)
models: Focus Mk2 (early), Fiesta Mk6, Fusion (EU), Mondeo Mk3 (late), C-Max (early), Transit Mk6/Mk7, F-150 (2008-2010), Escape (2008+)
notes: Fault codes are read with KWP2000 when a module doesn't speak UDS. Configuration support varies module by module.
